text: ボールから　でてしまうのは　げんきな　しょうこ！

structure.jp: ボールから　でてしまうのは
structure.en: its breaking out of the Ball

structure.jp: げんきな　しょうこ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb phrase turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. ボールから でてしまうのは = 'its breaking out of the Ball is'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, often as something unwanted. でてしまう = 'goes and gets out'.
